title: Embedded dashboard declaration (fabric-dashboard/0.1, DEC-0036)
description: The value a service puts under the extension key https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-contract/extensions/dashboard/0.1 in its well-known document's extensions (ED-9): the page's floor width, the appearance fields it applies, the themes it ships and the kit it is built from.

minWidth.description: The page's floor in CSS pixels (ED-1). A host gives the page at least max(480, minWidth) (ED-7).

appearance.description: The fabric_appearance cookie fields the page applies (ED-8).

themes.description: Theme ids the page ships (ED-10). The reference set is graphite, fabric, paper, forest, ocean, ember, contrast; other ids are free.

kit.description: The dashboard kit the page is built from, name@semver.
